content.text:
test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready >/dev/null 2>&1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
    restart: unless-stopped

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:10.4.3
    container_name: sva-studio-grafana
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3001:3000"
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER: "admin"
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: "${GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}"
      GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP: "false"
      GF_SERVER_HTTP_PORT: "3000"
    volumes:
      - grafana-data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./dev/monitoring/grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./dev/monitoring/grafana/dashboards:/etc/grafana/dashboards:ro
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.95.0
    container_name: sva-studio-otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otel-collector.yml"]
    environment:
      GOLOG_LEVEL: debug
    volumes:
      - ./dev/monitoring/otel-collector/otel-collector.yml:/etc/otel-collector.yml:ro
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:4317:4317"
      - "127.0.0.1:4318:4318"
      - "127.0.0.1:13133:13133"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.1'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/otelcol-contrib", "validate", "--config=/etc/otel-collector.yml"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
    restart: unless-stopped

  promtail:
    image: grafana/promtail@sha256:45d54f0ebd7a19acbcd4693a3227d84d27d98abe1dc7ea3068d31d5d02dbe696
    container_name: sva-studio-promtail
    environment:
      DOCKER_API_VERSION: "1.44"
    volumes:
      - /var/lib/docker/containers:/var/lib/docker/containers:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - ./dev/monitoring/promtail/promtail-config.yml:/etc/promtail/config.yml:ro
    command: ["-config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml"]
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3101:3101"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
          cpus: '0.1'
    depends_on:
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/usr/bin/promtail", "-check-syntax", "-config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
    restart: unless-stopped

  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.27.0
    container_name: sva-studio-alertmanager
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./dev/monitoring/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - alertmanager-data:/alertmanager
    command:
      - "--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml"
      - "--storage.path=/alertmanager"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128M
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
          cpus: '0.1'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy >/dev/null 2>&1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus

volumes:
  prometheus-data:
    driver: local
  loki-data:
    driver: local
  grafana-data:
    driver: local
  alertmanager-data:
    driver: local
